'''Terrab''' was a member of the [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Falner Oeth]] claimed that Terrab and [[Sabini]] were among those blocking his efforts to start a [[Killik/Legends|Killik]]-Imperial alliance.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />
